messages:
alex: FYI I pushed a short PRD draft for the KV eviction + kernel-fallback behavior that product wants prioritized for Q3. link: https://redwood.internal/prd/kv-eviction-draft :eyes:

mira: reading it now. quick note: the current runtime can flip kernels mid-request if cache miss patterns change — we should call that out as an operational risk in the PRD.

cheng: agree. also customer ask (FinX) requires p95 < 120ms for chat paths. that means eviction + kernel switches mustn't blow the tail. we need an acceptance test plan.

priya: prioritization ask from Sales: they want a timeline and a clear roll-back. can we map effort -> impact so we can promise a pilot to FinX?

alex: proposal in the doc: (1) canary rollout for 5% traffic, (2) monitor p50/p95/p99, kernel-switch rate, and KV miss amplification factor, (3) automatic rollback if p95 increases by >25% over baseline for 10m.

sam: add SLO guardrails: if errors increase or p99 > 250ms, immediate traffic cut to stable. also need an oncall playbook snippet.

mira: for implementation details I'm proposing a two-stage eviction policy: prefer per-tenant LRU with prefetched prefixes pinned; when global memory pressure triggers, use a weighted eviction that reduces thrash for hot prefixes. will add sketch to RFC.

cheng: sketch looks good. need to clarify multi-tenant fairness objective — top-level metric: tail amplification ratio per-tenant <= 1.5x. also define long-prefix edge-case where prefix reuse across sessions could be large.

alex: acceptance criteria in doc (draft):
- p95 latency for pilot workload <= 120ms baseline
- kernel-switch events per minute <= baseline * 1.2
- no more than 2 customer-visible errors per 10k requests during canary
- rollout automation supports immediate rollback and traffic-split config

priya: can we add a priority tag to the roadmap: if pilot passes, GA in next minor release; if pilot fails, we have a mitigation path (increase dedicated pool for affected tenant). Sales needs that to negotiate contract.

mira: for rollout config I'm suggesting something like:
```
rollout:
  canary_percent: 5
  metrics_window: 10m
  fail_conditions:
    - name: p95_latency_delta
      threshold: 25
      comparator: percent_increase
    - name: kernel_switch_rate
      threshold: 1.2
      comparator: multiplier
  fallback_kernel: stable-v1
```

sam: include an automated smoke test that runs a steady-state replay for 15m during canary and a short burst test to surface tail regressions. also add alert: canary-failed -> ps page + auto-cut.

cheng: edge cases to call out in PRD: very long single-session prefixes (>64k tokens), model-variant quantized kernels that don't have exact KV semantics, and cross-region cache warmup latency.

alex: good list. also note resource estimate: eng ~3 sprint dev + 1 sprint rollout/ops, infra changes for eviction metrics + rollout flags ~2 sprint infra, ml + runtime sweep ~1 sprint. total ~6 sprints by combined teams.

priya: is this high or medium priority relative to other Q3 items? Sales says high for FinX, but product needs tradeoffs. Alex — can you add a short prioritization matrix in the PRD (customer revenue impact vs engineering effort)?

alex: will add matrix. quick ask to reviewers: please comment on the metrics and acceptance criteria in the PRD by EOD Friday. if no major blockers, we tag RFC-impl and schedule a 30m sync next week. :thumbsup:

mira: +1; I'll add the eviction pseudocode and perf test plan.

cheng: I'll prototype a kernel-fallback mapping table and test it against quantized variants.

sam: I'll draft the canary playbook and oncall steps.

deploy-bot: New doc created: /prs/kv-eviction-prd-draft (by alex) — reviewers requested: mira, cheng, sam, priya.

alex: thanks team. if anyone has high-risk concerns call them out now — otherwise I'll move PRD to RFC in 24h.

mira: one more: add a metric for "eviction-induced cold starts" (count) and tie it to rollback thresholds. that captures warmup pain.

cheng: +1 on cold-start metric. also log example request ids for postmortem if rollout sees regression.

priya: perfect. i'll prep customer comms draft template for FinX pilot and link it in the PRD.

alex: closing note — try to keep replies short in the thread so we can merge decisions into the PRD quickly. will ping for the 30m sync once RFC is ready. :rocket:
